fusions.name: Honed on the Doorpost
fusions.desc: A raking weapon strike that deals 4 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, and leaves it 6% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Four-Point Landing
fusions.desc: Lands on all fours with your full weight, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Not a Scratch
fusions.desc: Springs you 3 tiles from where you stood. For 2 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. Transcendent damage still lands.

fusions.name: Ninth Rivet
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
